front: A 1-inch onyx statuette of a dog. Set it on solid ground and speak its name to turn it into a living guard dog that obeys you.
back:
Activate (2 actions) command, Interact: place on solid ground and speak its name. Once per week; lasts up to 6 hours.
The dog is a minion, understands your language, and obeys when you spend an action to command it.
Darkvision; +4 circumstance bonus to Survival to Track. A hidden creature it senses by scent becomes observed and concealed instead.
Slain as a dog: reverts to a statue and can't be activated for 1 week. Destroyed as a statue: its magic is lost.
